schema: CREATE TABLE sensor_readings (reading_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, status_code INTEGER);
correct_query: SELECT r1.reading_id FROM sensor_readings AS r1 WHERE r1.status_code = 1 AND ((SELECT status_code FROM sensor_readings AS r2 WHERE r2.reading_id = r1.reading_id - 1) = 1 OR (SELECT status_code FROM sensor_readings AS r2 WHERE r2.reading_id = r1.reading_id + 1) = 1)

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Replaces individual equality checks r1.status_code = 1 AND r2.status_code = 1 with product r1.status_code * r2.status_code = 1, which also holds for (-1) * (-1) = 1
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT DISTINCT r1.reading_id FROM sensor_readings AS r1 CROSS JOIN sensor_readings AS r2 WHERE ABS(r2.reading_id - r1.reading_id) = 1 AND r1.status_code * r2.status_code = 1 ORDER BY r1.reading_id
